title: Turkish Passive Voice (-il / -in)
summary: Forming passive verbs where the object becomes the subject.
explanation: Attach '-il/-ıl/-ul/-ül' (or '-in' after vowels) to the verb stem to make it passive (e.g., okundu = was read).

common_error_explanations.err_trpas_1: Use passive suffixes when the actor is unknown or secondary.
